title: haex-hive Visibility Marker v1 (trust-git amendment)
description: Schema for .haex-hive/visibility.json — the sole publication event for a completed haex install transaction. Per the 2026-09-01 trust-git amendment, the marker carries the generation_id and the participating-root names only; per-root and per-lock `content_integrity` digests are retired (git provides byte-identity for committed content). See Spec 008 FR-004, FR-005.

haex_hive_version.description: Matches the Spec 007 unified-manifest version this install belongs to.

generation_id.description: Time-based, collision-checked generation identifier. See Spec 008 research §R8.

items.description: Repo-relative directory with trailing slash, e.g. '.haex-hive/'.

participating_roots.description: Names of the participating output roots covered by this publication. Order MUST be lexicographic for determinism.

written_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 wall-clock at marker write. Informational only.
